Here’s the gate mapping structure I’d use once I have the parent issues. It’s designed so each parent issue gets an explicit “go/no-go” path across build, test, drift, routing, and rollback.

| Parent Issue | Build Gate | Test Gate | Drift Gate | Routing Gate | Rollback Gate |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Parent issue title / number | What must compile, generate, or validate before merge | Which unit/integration/proof commands must pass | What generated/runtime/projection files must be checked for divergence | Which skill/router/operator path must select the right behavior | How to revert safely, disable behavior, or restore prior projection |
| Example: skill behavior change | `./bin/ask skills prove <handle> --json --robot` plus relevant package build if inside a package root | Focused tests for changed skill, fixtures, and command behavior | Confirm canonical source and runtime projection are synchronized | Confirm discovery/routing selects the intended skill and does not shadow unrelated skills | Revert canonical skill change, regenerate projection, restore previous route metadata |
| Example: policy or agent docs change | `./bin/ask repo doctor --json --robot` | Documentation validation or policy tests if present | Confirm docs, policy indexes, and runtime projections agree | Confirm affected agent guide points to the right canonical doc | Revert doc/policy source, rerun projection/sync, verify old guidance is restored |
| Example: runtime projection change | Projection generation command, if applicable | Tests proving projection consumers still load expected files | Compare canonical source vs projected output | Confirm consumers resolve projected path correctly | Regenerate from previous canonical state or revert projection artifact |
| Example: routing/discovery change | Build/doctor plus routing explain command | Tests for route selection and negative cases | Confirm generated indexes/cache do not drift from canonical routing metadata | `./bin/ask skills explain <handle> --json --robot` for expected path | Restore previous route metadata/index, rerun explain/prove |
| Example: sync/install workflow change | Repo doctor plus workflow-specific command | Tests for install/audit/fold/sync flow | Confirm installed/runtime outputs match canonical source | Confirm workflow invokes the intended source of truth | Restore previous installer/sync behavior and rerun closeout |
